mentions.name: Soccer Nations
mentions.description: A VR soccer game for Meta Quest, a rewritten version of the author's older soccer game with updated gameplay and graphics, focused on international tournaments; player and tournament names are not licensed so they are not fully real.
mentions.source_excerpt: Actually they're just rewritten versions of my older games (one Soccer and one Basketball), but now focused on international tournaments with updated gameplay and graphics. I have no licensing for the player names and tournament names are also not fully real for same reason.
mentions.author: random-exceptio
